title: Kiln ROCm/HF Numerical Path Attribution Result v2
description: Source-bound comparison of four Kiln ROCm paths—eager full logits, eager greedy selection, retained HIP-graph full logits, and retained HIP-graph greedy selection—against one retained eager Hugging Face full-vocabulary reference at the exact first-divergence state.
